title: HOW TO #7: Build a Dog House Before the Storm
caption:
How to build a dog house before the storm 🐕⛈️

Your dog is outside and a storm is coming in 1 hour. 10 problems, 10 fixes: 4 boards, a slanted roof, 4 bricks under the floor, foam on the walls, 4 pegs in the ground, a rubber flap, a vent, a plastic sheet, a soft mat. Dry, warm, anchored. Your dog sleeps while the storm passes.

Which fix mattered most: the roof, the foam or the pegs? Comment DOG below. Tag the friend with the spoiled dog. Follow @StickMindR8 for HOW TO #8!
